name: Extract duplicated helper
prompt: The file solution.py contains validate_username and validate_display_name with near-identical validation blocks that have drifted apart: validate_display_name incorrectly allows one extra character (limit 21 instead of 20). Extract a single shared helper (e.g., `_validate_short_string(value, field_name, max_length=20)`) and have both functions call it, so both enforce a consistent 20-character limit. Return the FULL corrected contents of solution.py and nothing else — no explanation, no markdown fences.
